Criteria.Purpose: Compare measurement duration and fidelity with Dynamic PGO ON; no production edits or fast-state selection.
Criteria.Primary: Eight independent launches per variant per profile, balanced AB/BA within eight blocks; no exclusions or optional stopping.
Criteria.CandidateAcceptance: Callsite launch CV <=3%, mean within-launch CV <=5%; paired-block 95% t interval for method/reference geometric ratio fully within 0.97..1.03. These are operational acceptance criteria, not universal guarantees.
Criteria.Drift: Record first-half versus second-half Actual means for every process; absolute drift >3% is flagged, not deleted.
Criteria.NegativeControl: Baseline retains historical profile sensitivity; do not call a method universally stable because the current candidate is stable.
Criteria.AA: Callsite odd/even blocks are a same-binary null comparison per profile; report an independent-groups log-ratio interval with a conservative t critical value at df=3 (n=4/4). Small samples cannot establish a false-positive rate.
Criteria.Timing: Compare measured wall times, not only requested iteration counts. Diagnostic launches are separate.
Criteria.Limit: No extra trials; stop by 2026-10-05T04:40:00Z to leave reporting time before the one-hour checkpoint.

Limitations: One 4 MB input, one CPU/machine and runtime version; counts are not general microbenchmark defaults.
Eight launches per cell; rare slow launches and false-positive rates are not established.
Pairwise 95% log-ratio t intervals are individual intervals with approximate distributional assumptions, not simultaneous coverage.
Same-binary A/A uses only 4+4 launches and a conservative df=3 critical value; lack of significance is not proof of equivalence.
EventPipe perturbs timings and potentially PGO profiles; four diagnostic launches are not pooled with plain timings.
No target-assembly Tier1 transitions during Actual was observed in the two warmup16 diagnostic processes; not guaranteed for every future launch.
No trials/outliers removed. Background activity remains possible. CPU counters are not exact clock/temperature measurements.
Balanced power plan was fixed; AC/battery status query was access-denied, so AC power was not verified.
